review.description: S1-S3 subscription challenge, delivery, filtering and refresh behavior remain unchanged. Recovery writes ordinary journal attention/run events; host callback acceptance remains explicitly open and is not inferred from UI confirmation.
review.implementation: Compared events service and notification transport with the baseline: no event subscription/callback code changed. Recovery uses existing Store event writes and the confirmation is view-local React state, with no new host notification call or background delivery mechanism.
review.tests: Inspected subscription verification/retry/dedup/refresh/expiry and callback safety assertions. They rerun in fixture mode, while browser response confirmation checks only local owning-run status. No fixture receipt closes real host callback challenge/delivery gaps.
